info.name: HPE OmniStack REST backups datastores API
Retrieves all datastores defined on this system

params.name: show_optional_fields
params.description:
An indicator to show the hypervisor_free_space of the datastore

Note: This value is computed from various sources. Consequently, the retrieval of this value may adversely affect the response time of a request.

params.name: id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the datastores to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: name
params.description:
The name of the datastores to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: min_size
params.description: The minimum size (in bytes) of datastores to return

params.name: max_size
params.description: The maximum size (in bytes) of datastores to return

params.name: created_before
params.description: The latest creation time before the datastores to return were created, expressed in ISO-8601 form, based on Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

params.name: created_after
params.description: The earliest creation time after the datastores to return were created, expressed in ISO-8601 form, based on Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

params.name: omnistack_cluster_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the omnistack_cluster that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: omnistack_cluster_name
params.description:
The name of the omnistack_cluster that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: compute_cluster_parent_hypervisor_object_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the hypervisor-based instance that contains the omnistack_cluster that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: compute_cluster_parent_name
params.description:
The name of the hypervisor-based instance that contains the omnistack_cluster that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: hypervisor_management_system_name
params.description:
The name of the Hypervisor Management System (HMS) associated with the datastore

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: policy_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the policy that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: policy_name
params.description:
The name of the policy that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: hypervisor_object_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the hypervisor-based instance  that is associated with the instances to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: mount_directory
params.description:
The mount point on the system associated with the datastores to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: cluster_group_id
params.description:
The unique identifiers (UIDs) of the cluster_groups associated with the datastores to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: fields
params.description:
A comma-separated list of fields to include in the returned objects

 Default: Returns all fields

params.name: limit
params.description:
A positive integer that represents the maximum number of results to return

Default: 500

params.name: offset
params.description:
A positive integer that directs the service to start returning the <offset value> instance, up to the limit

Default: 0

params.name: case
params.description:
An indicator that specifies if the filter and sort results use a case-sensitive or insensitive manner

Valid values: sensitive or insensitive

Default: sensitive

params.name: sort
params.description: The name of the field where the sort occurs

params.name: order
params.description:
The sort order preference

Valid values: ascending or descending

Default: descending

params.name: single_replica
params.description: Whether the datastore contains only single-replica virtual machines (no storage HA)
